Name: Lock Items (Protect Stacks from Chests)
Author: Jejcofa
Description:
[size=6][b]Lock Items Mod[/b][/size]

A lightweight Quality of Life (QoL) mod for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] that allows you to lock items in your inventory so they won't be transferred to chests when clicking the "Add to Existing Stacks" button.
[line]

[size=5][b]🎮 How to Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Hover your cursor over an item in your inventory or hotbar.[/*]
[*]Click the [b]Middle Mouse Button (MMB)[/b] (or your custom bound key).[/*]
[*]A subtle click sound will play and a golden padlock icon will appear on the item.[/*]
[*]Open any chest and hit [b]"Add to Existing Stacks"[/b] — your locked items will stay right where they are![/*]
[*]Click [b]MMB[/b] again anytime to unlock the item.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size]

You can configure options in-game using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], or by editing the generated [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]:
[list]
[*][b]ToggleLockKey:[/b] The key to lock/unlock items (default: [i]MouseMiddle[/i]).[/*]
[*][b]PlaySoundOnToggle:[/b] Play a sound effect when locking/unlocking (default: [i]true[/i]).[/*]
[*][b]LockIconScale:[/b] Size scaling of the lock icon (default: [i]2.0[/i]).[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] (version 4.0.0 or higher).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [font=Courier New]LockItemsMod[/font] folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🌐 Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/*]
[*]Compatible with multiplayer (client-only; other players don't need it).[/*]
[*]Compatible with Big Chests, Junimo Chests, and custom modded chests.[/*]
[*]Compatible with controller / custom keyboard binds via configuration.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⭐ My Other Mods[/b][/size]

[list]

[/list]
